common: Create a production15-frame animation atlas for our browser game: an original rich16-bit pixel-art redraw of the ACTUAL Plants vs Zombies INFI-NUT in reference1, rendered in approved rich pixel style reference2. FIVE columns by THREE rows,15complete separated poses in equal square cells, generous margins, constant scale/design and all faceRIGHT three-quarter view. Uniform pale cream background, no text/borders/shadows/ground/particles/detached rays. Canonical Infi-nut: large rounded upright oval WALL-NUT SHAPE made of CYAN/AQUA BLUE holographic light, lumpy ridged shell silhouette and subtle geometric scan facets, bright cyan inner outline, two large luminous OFF-WHITE EYES with NO black pupils, small gentle mouth. Body is NOT brown nut, purple/pink gem or robot person. It is PROJECTED just above a short wide elliptical METALLIC GREY projector ring with cyan aperture and exactly3small cyan round lamps, over a low dark-green LEAF BASE. A short attached pale-cyan triangular projection funnel connects projector to nut; this is character anatomy, not an external aura. Use only opaque crisp pixel ramps for holographic material, no semitransparent pixels or blur; empty cream backdrop stays plain. Thin navy contour for approved sprite readability plus bright cyan edge. No human arms, legs, feet, boots, hands or clothes. Exact reading-order layout: ROW1col1 IDLEA, row1col2 IDLEB hologram gently pulses/facets shift; row1col3 WALK1 projector/rootbase glides right while nut bends slightly; row1col4 WALK2 base settles nut upright; row1col5 WALK3 opposite natural glide/lean still facingRIGHT. ROW2col1 WALK4 settle; row2col2 ATTACKWINDUP nut draws back scan facets compress; row2col3 ATTACKRELEASE nut pushes/leans towardRIGHT with broader shield outline and connected funnel, no beams/projectiles; row2col4 ATTACKRECOVERY body returns centered; row2col5 HURT squeeze eyes and body flinch with a few attached broken scan facets, never vanishes. ROW3col1 KO1 both eyesFULLYCLOSED as thin white arcs, cyan nut slumps lower toward projector; row3col2 KO2 both eyesFULLYCLOSED as thin white arcs, hologram remains readable but squat/dim blue resting over base. Row3col3 CHEER1 happy upward white crescent-eye arcs and nut rises proudly; row3col4 CHEER2 different happy-eye stretch and scan facet opening; row3col5 SLEEP both eyesFULLYCLOSED as downward white eyelid arcs, hologram dims/droops calmly above projector. White glowing eyes must visibly close in KO/SLEEP, no open white eye ovals there. Keep projector/leaf base intact and centered throughout.15distinct drawn poses.

variants.desc: Stage0 INFI-NUT: match actual compact oval cyan holographic nut with lumpy ridged shell edge, blank luminous white eyes and tiny gentle smile, hovering closely above one simple short gray ring projector on green base leaves. No extra shield rings or fortified machine tiers yet. Canonical recognizable basic plant.

Stage1 INFI-SHIELD is a project evolution: preserve canonical cyan oval holographic nut/white blank eyes/short projection funnel and gray3lamp ring projector on low green leaf base. Add ONE clean attached cyan-blue HOLOGRAPHIC SHIELD RING just behind nut, a thin oval framing protective rim with a few segmented scan breaks, not a separate loose effect. Slightly sturdier projector. Nut is still central identity, not a face painted on an energy ball or humanoid shield carrier. Happy/friendly.

Stage2 INFI-FORTRESS is a project final evolution: canonical cyan oval holographic nut with pale blank eyes and gentle smile remains central; richer angular blue scan facets and a stronger attached segmented cyan protective rim. Broader low continuous elliptical gray STEPPED PROJECTOR PLATFORM with flat reinforced plates and cyan lamps over green root leaves; mechanically fortified BASE only, no robot limbs/feet, turrets, crown or armor clothes. Keep connected short projection funnel and hologram nut body. Larger robust cyan protective silhouette, not a pink crystal or metal humanoid.
